verdicts.reason: Both are ~320x50 banners, so tiny that everything is hard to read. A: the headline is minuscule, with text far too small to read, and the wind-turbine icon is replaced by a few small indistinct shapes (green, blue, red) and faint lines. The brand mark is lost. B: the headline is much larger and readable, and a turbine icon survives next to the triangles. The decor is cramped at the far right and the icon is very small. The layout is left-heavy with a large empty gap in the middle, but it is still clearly the better of the two.
